# Ai Labs

> AI consulting, business automation and practical education for teams and professionals. Based in El Salvador.

## Services

Ai Labs helps teams understand their work, identify where AI can help and prioritize a concrete next step.

- **Academy** — Practical education for professionals and teams, with work-based practice and criteria for reviewing AI output. Individuals can come directly to learn.
- **Agentic** — Workflow design and implementation, including integrations, human review, documentation and handover.

Consulting and implementation follow three steps: understand, prioritize and put into practice. Scope and outcomes are agreed around the need. Consulting prices and packages are not published.

**Aperture** brings together community, events and partnerships. It is accessible through Community and the footer.

## Primary URLs

- Website and services: https://ailabs.sv/#services
- How we work: https://ailabs.sv/#about
- Community: https://ailabs.sv/community
- Campus Leaders: https://ailabs.sv/campus-leader

English or Spanish is chosen via cookie or Accept-Language; language is not part of the URL.

## Contact

Use “Let’s talk” in the navigation or the contact section at https://ailabs.sv/#contact. The form accepts consulting, education, implementation and partnership inquiries; a company is optional.
